title: Web UI: gate in-progress animation on active task, not derived status
description:
Gate the `ap-in-progress` animated glow/ping on `hasActiveTask` (an actively in-progress task exists), not on the derived phase/feature status. Derived-`in-progress`-but-idle gets a subtle static border/bg only.

Files: `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree-rows.tsx` — feature row className ~L99 + phase row className ~L201. Both currently use `${status === "in-progress" ? "ap-in-progress" : hasActiveTask ? "<subtle>" : ""}`; swap to `${hasActiveTask ? "ap-in-progress" : status === "in-progress" ? "<subtle>" : ""}`. Task rows (~L308) already gate on `task.status === "in-progress"` — leave them.

`hasActiveTask` is already computed in `packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/dashboard-tree.ts:74,96` (`allTasks.some(t => t.status === "in-progress")` for phases; `allPhases.some(e => e.hasActiveTask)` for features). No new data needed.

Behaviors to preserve: the subtle border/bg for the idle-but-in-progress state stays (just no animation); done styling (opacity-70) unchanged; recently-changed ring unchanged. Build: `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/web-ui build` then `scripts/copy-web-ui.sh` to sync `packages/pi-adapter/web-ui-dist`.

tasks.title: Gate ap-in-progress animation on hasActiveTask (feature + phase rows)
tasks.description:
In `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree-rows.tsx`, swap the animation gating on the feature row (~L99) and phase row (~L201):

Current (both rows): `${status === "in-progress" ? "ap-in-progress" : hasActiveTask ? "<subtle border/bg>" : ""}`
New: `${hasActiveTask ? "ap-in-progress" : status === "in-progress" ? "<subtle border/bg>" : ""}`

This gates the full `ap-in-progress` animated glow on `hasActiveTask` (an actively in-progress task exists), and gives the derived-`in-progress`-but-idle state only the subtle static border/bg. Task rows (~L308) already gate on `task.status === "in-progress"` — leave them unchanged.

`hasActiveTask` is already computed in `packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/dashboard-tree.ts:74` (phases: `allTasks.some(t => t.status === "in-progress")`) + L96 (features: `allPhases.some(e => e.hasActiveTask)`) — no new data needed.

Verify: `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/web-ui build` + `pnpm check` clean. Then `bash scripts/copy-web-ui.sh` to sync the bundle to `packages/pi-adapter/web-ui-dist`. Visual check: a phase with done tasks but no in-progress task shows subtle border/bg (no pulse); a phase with an in-progress task shows the animated glow.
